# ZenStory AI

> Open-source AI tools and agent skills for story creation, adaptation, and production. Create stories. Adapt them. Ship them — from web fiction and short drama to games and video. Everything is MIT-licensed and maintained at https://github.com/zenstory-ai.

ZenStory AI (GitHub org `zenstory-ai`) publishes six projects. Five are skill packs / plugins for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, Google Antigravity, OpenCode, ZCode, OpenClaw, Kimi Code and DeepSeek Harness; one is a hosted writing workbench. Choose by the material and deliverable: plan or revise fiction, adapt a story into short drama or a game, or turn footage into narrated video. Projects have separate setup and workspace requirements; this is not an automatic cross-product pipeline.

Canonical install path for the skill packs is the GitHub repository under `zenstory-ai/` (e.g. `npx skills add zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`). Repositories were previously hosted under `worldwonderer/`; those paths permanently redirect here.

## Projects

Overview page: https://zenstory.ai/projects — each project has a bilingual canonical page with its definition, audience, workflow, capability limits and dated, versioned source notes. Those notes identify the reviewed source snapshot, not a guarantee about later releases.

- [Oh Story (oh-story-claudecode)](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode): Thirteen agent skills for web-fiction research, deconstruction, drafting, revision and covers. Chart data depends on available sources; historical fallback is labeled. Pattern checks do not establish authorship or guarantee AI-detector scores. Host capabilities determine orchestration support.
- [Drama Skills (drama-skills)](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills): Eleven skills for short-drama and motion-comic scripts, visual specifications, storyboards and generation prompts. Documents and stages are selected as needed. Media production requires configured providers and explicit spending confirmation; review is separately requested.
- [Novel to Game (novel-to-game)](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/novel-to-game): Seven agent skills for source-grounded adaptation into a game candidate on a selected target runtime. Six runtime QA checks record execution evidence, not subjective quality or readiness for commercial release.
- [Video Recap Skills (video-recap-skills)](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/video-recap-skills): Six skills total — five stage skills plus one orchestrator — for Chinese-narration video recaps and optional CapCut/JianYing draft export. ffmpeg processes media locally; MiMo and optional Fish Audio services handle remote model tasks. Final output requires playback review.
- [Oh Story DSH (oh-story-dsh)](https://zenstory.ai/dsh) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-dsh): A community DeepSeek Harness plugin with pinned novel, short-drama, game and video skill packs and four workbenches. The local DSH Web environment and model/media services require configuration. Package: `@oh-story/dsh`; not affiliated with, partnered with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
- [ZenStory workbench (zenstory)](https://zenstory.ai/workbench) · [source](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/zenstory): A conversation-first writing workspace for project files, materials, characters, drafts and version history. Hosted at https://app.zenstory.ai; self-hosting requires backend/model configuration. See the project page for version limits and the published privacy-policy statement.

## Documentation

- [Learn writing craft from fiction](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction): original poster-proof evidence and bounded interpretation lead to two different garden plans, then a new prose passage where an uncertain staffing proposal fails and the smaller order happens. Transfer the useful constraint, not the source wording or gestures; keeps analysis/import, partial-reading and saved-progress boundaries.

- [Write distinct character dialogue](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-dialogue): original rehearsal alternatives distinguish agenda, knowledge and relationship; a direct answer corrects a misunderstanding without making a private fact common knowledge. Compare the pace cost instead of forcing every line into a question, preserve the recording decision, and vary one speaker’s wording by listener without catchphrase formulas.

- [Plan a complete short story from one premise](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/short-story-from-idea): an original six-section repair-shop plan plus opening, negotiation and quiet-ending excerpts; distinguish an earned agreement from completed repair, and editorial samples from the later full-story file without mandatory twists or quota filler.

- [Turn manuscript feedback into a revision plan](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/review-and-revise): an original decision sheet and revised transfer-slip scene turn an accepted agency diagnosis into action without an unapproved reveal; distinguish agreement from completed registration, chat-only trials from saved revisions, and concrete later-chapter impacts.

- [Preserve your author voice](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/preserve-author-voice): an original sample-to-prose comparison separates expressive choices from a paragraph formula. A written local exception keeps extended observation without the semicolon pattern or joke; book facts and scoped preferences remain distinct from sample inference, with no copied plot or guaranteed voice match.

- [From outline to chapter](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter): an original library outline becomes a staged opening and a continuation through conditional cooperation, brief transport and a concrete ending; preserves character depth, agreed chapter boundaries and the distinction between chat excerpts and saved prose.

- [Keep a long novel consistent](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity): an original letter-and-deadline handoff separates author truth, character knowledge and reader knowledge; an optional clue-payoff design prepares evidence, corrects a plausible interpretation and changes the next action without prematurely completing delivery.

- [Original sound versus recap narration](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/original-audio-and-narration): an original radio edit compares shorter context copy with omitting it, protects the click-and-wait evidence and complete dialogue, and separates expression, sound decisions and actual mix changes; no invented motives or guaranteed TTS fit.

- [Character consistency and reference-image choices](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/character-consistency): an original archive three-shot example separates identity, compatible Look, locks and changing states, then tests portrait/costume/location/boundary-frame uses; real REF files versus external PLAN entry locators, the fixed-episode Look exception and no forced suite regeneration.

- [Make novel-game choices matter](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices): an original ferry scene becomes advance information, action buttons, separate consent and three ending passages; two decisions retain testimony, records and route history without moralized options, invented punishment or a generated-game claim.

- [Export a manuscript from the workbench](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/export): saved draft/script selection, sequence-aware TXT export, a separate review copy, and bringing back chosen offline edits; not a whole-project backup.
- [Choose the scope of version recovery](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/version-history): file versions versus project snapshots, comparing before recovery and preserving independent copies.
- [Browser writing workflow: decisions to saved prose](https://zenstory.ai/docs/advanced/workflow-tips): an original scene-two handoff separates inherited facts, approved design and actual saved outcomes; scoped revision, file/context choices, version/export limits and no fixed productivity or prompt-count promise.
- [Accepted screenplay to storyboard](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/script-to-storyboard): direct entry from current scene and visual facts; compare an original four-shot sketch with a continuous two-shot to choose attention, shared space and readable detail without changing dialogue, hand continuity or the unresolved ending. Sound-first timings remain provisional. A reveal map and unaccepted rewrite distinguish camera choices from screenplay changes.
- [Material analysis: source evidence to your own scene](https://zenstory.ai/docs/advanced/material-analysis): an original recording passage separates evidence from interpretation, then transfers a changed goal and remaining cost to a different toy-car practice scene; candidate choices, prose excerpt and separate reading notes, not renamed props or a recorded model run.
- [Use reference materials in the browser workbench](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/materials): TXT byte/character limits, asynchronous decomposition and partial-error states, result categories and explicit chat attachments; not automatic whole-library context or manuscript-project import.
- [AI Memory: settings, progress and open ideas](https://zenstory.ai/docs/advanced/ai-memory): four editable project-summary fields, saved facts versus future plans, context budgets and an original correction example; not guaranteed full-book recall or complete-project backup.
- [AI writing assistant: context and continuation](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/ai-assistant): focused saved files, material attachments, text quotes, scoped requests, character-consistency checks and recovery after interrupted generation.
- [Revise a passage in the workbench editor](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/editor): an original before/after scene edit, manual writing, quotations, review decisions and save/conflict boundaries; not an offline-backup or automatic-quality promise.
- [Start writing in the browser workbench](https://zenstory.ai/docs/getting-started/quick-start): create with or without an idea, target project files, request scoped help, save and export; no agent-host installation required.
- [Write your first short story in ZenStory](https://zenstory.ai/docs/getting-started/first-project): original lost-property premise, approved facts versus open choices, character/outline/draft files, context selection, local revision and TXT export limits.
- [Revise formulaic AI prose](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose): original before/after and connected-cadence alternatives; preserve purposeful repetition and scene facts instead of mechanically shortening prose; distinguish pasted-fragment revision, detection only and in-place file edits, without authorship or detector-score claims.
- [Turn video into grounded Chinese narration](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration): original no-dialogue evidence, two story angles and a short script; distinguish a crossed-out claim from a timed result, then handle partial footage through a missing-evidence request or a clearly narrower script without inventing the ending; includes full/cut and remote-stage boundaries.
- [Import an unfinished novel and continue writing](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue): an original harbor-radio handoff separates manuscript history, uncertain reconstruction and author-chosen future direction; continue an already-made decision without rewriting old chapters, inventing a successful repair or treating a local promise as complete reconciliation.
- [Adapt a novel into short drama](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/novel-to-short-drama): source facts, adaptation choices and one-episode versus three-episode cuts of an original repair-shop story; a scoped dialogue revision changes the mother’s response without erasing the rent problem or daughter’s decision. Includes a prose-to-four-shots handoff, separate from media generation.
- [Turn character motives into story choices](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-motivation): goals, motives and habitual tactics become an original fantasy-relay plan and close-third-person scene; show resistance, a partner’s independent contribution and an agreement that is not yet delivery. Separate factual contradictions, disputed dialogue and changed tactics without forcing a growth arc.
- [Agent skills for writers: prompts, skill packs, plugins and MCP](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers): a non-programmer guide to the different layers, choosing a writing task, planning without prose versus chat-only proposals, actual planning files and author decisions before the first chapter.
- [Write a novel with DeepSeek: choose a workspace and continue a draft](https://zenstory.ai/dsh/deepseek-novel-writing): distinguishes chat, the DSH host/plugin and hosted workbench; an original archive mystery separates accepted chapters, unfinished text and discarded plans, compares two consequential next scenes, then scopes discussion, full import or partial-chapter revision without inventing a solved mystery.
- [Choose a writing workflow](https://zenstory.ai/compare/writing-workflows): first-party comparison of Oh Story skills, the pinned DSH plugin and hosted ZenStory; host/configuration/file/version boundaries and a reversible trial checklist, not a ranking or price/privacy guarantee.
- [Novel-to-game quick start](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start): explicit source coverage and an original ferry slice-selection brief; turn first-candidate feedback into a scoped wording fix, implementation repair or approved design change without rerolling the concept; includes design/build handoffs and runtime evidence boundaries.
- [Export and finish a JianYing / CapCut recap draft](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft): an original rehearsal edit compares moving commentary after the result with an original-audio-led short cut; preserve source evidence, align voice/captions/volume changes, and distinguish the editor version from the pipeline snapshot. Export-only uses an existing timeline, not a flattened MP4 or automatic round-trip sync.
- [Workbench docs](https://zenstory.ai/docs): getting started, user guide, advanced, reference, troubleshooting (English and Chinese).
- [Organization overview](https://zenstory.ai/projects): which project to start with, based on what you want to make.
- [Oh Story changelog](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
